extension.description: A dark, cinematic Kodi skin with glass panels and large backdrops. Works with every video add-on: any add-on folder can be a row on Home, with trailers on posters, a full info page, a calendar, sport and live TV.

Een donkere, cinematische Kodi-skin met glazen panelen en grote achtergronden. Werkt met elke video-add-on: elke map van een add-on kan een rij op Home worden, met trailers op posters, een volledige infopagina, een kalender, sport en live tv.
extension.news: 2.1.3: New intro at start (about 6 seconds, sharp on 4K, with a warm sound that has its own switch in Skin settings) and the new logo everywhere in the skin. Continue watching from your library holds the real films and episodes, with Kodi's full menu. Rows no longer jump when a trailer loads or a menu opens over Home. Media flags in the lists as white logos (4K, Dolby Vision, HDR10, Atmos, TrueHD, DTS, 7.1 …), plus the source (Blu-ray, web, HDTV, DVD) for library files. OMDb / MDBList scores on Home too. On an episode on Home: episodes left in the season, and a season premiere / finale label. The update message also recognises in-between updates of your video add-on (beta 1, update 6). Skin settings: Right on Setup assistant, Backup and Kids mode lands on the OK button, so you see where you are. The Continue watching row from your library can be switched off (Skin settings, on by default). 2.1.2: Trailers on Home no longer start and stop over and over (the loading circle and the jump to the row below are gone). A–Z sorting now works for every Home row, also add-on folders that only give names and genre rows. The Streaming services row is tidy again: every logo on a calm dark card, without a second stretched logo or coloured blocks behind it. Trakt through your video add-on works with its new Trakt link (link it again once when the add-on asks). 2.1.1: Titles Lucent opens itself (Tonight for you, actors, collections, calendar) play with the video add-on you have, also TMDb Helper with your players; similar titles work with TMDb Helper too. Tonight for you is on the Home tab only, and only when an add-on can play its titles. The Continue watching row from the library shows films on the Films tab, series on the Series tab, and is gone from Home and the other tabs. The settings level button says what it does. 2.1.0 - RC 2: Release candidate 2. Big maintenance: the whole skin was checked for bugs and unused parts. Lucent works with every video add-on and with Lucent Video. Lucent's update message now also shows new versions of Lucent Video. On/off choices in Settings have a switch and rows that open another screen have an arrow everywhere. 2.0.4: The Continue watching row from your Kodi library is always on Home and holds series only. Lists remember the title you were on. IMDb is back on the first row when the other scores are off. Faster on new installations and lighter in the background; the animated streaming logos are gone. Ready for version 1.0 of your video add-on. 2.0.3: One Continue watching row from your Kodi library (Skin settings). Continue watching and next up in one row from your video add-on (Menu and widgets). With touch or a mouse the side menu only opens on its icons. Light mode in the setup assistant no longer hangs Kodi. No calendar notification button for films in your library. 2.0.1: Own Trakt login (Skin settings > Follow > Trakt login), works with every video add-on. Mark intro button in the player menu. 2.0.0 - RC 1: Release candidate 1. Big check-up: Lucent now works with your video add-on and your own add-on folders only; the code for one older video add-on is gone. Similar titles on the info page come from your video add-on. The skin no longer installs Lucent Subtitles by itself (your video add-on does subtitles); it stays in the Lucent repository for who only wants a subtitle add-on. The YouTube trailer fix moved to Help and info. Unused texts and code removed. 1.43.0: Season page: choose how the episodes are shown (side menu > Episodes as): Row, Timeline, Episode cards or List with flags. What's new: OK on a change opens it on its own with a picture, the whole explanation, how to use it in steps and a Try it now button. 1.42.0: Seven new views for series and episodes (List side menu > View). Series: Banner list (logo, how many episodes you saw, status), Progress rings (posters with a ring) and Mosaic (the chosen series big, the others as tiles). Episodes: Timeline (big stills on a line with dots for what you saw), Episode cards (two columns), Up next stack (with the reason, like where you stopped) and List with flags (4K, HDR, sound, subtitles). Music: Vinyl (a record turns slowly next to the sleeve, not in light mode), Artist wall, Album with track list, Coverflow and Discography timeline. Film series: Collection shelf. Everything: Recently added. The side menu now opens from every new view (Left on the first item) and Right goes back. 1.41.1: Clean-up: for films and series Lucent offers your video add-on and the folders of your own add-ons; the extra settings, buttons, setup step and texts for one other video add-on are gone. The hint on the season page now simply says OK: play. 1.41.0: Four new views for films and series: Spotlight, Wall with info panel, Carousel and Title card (List side menu > View). A trailer on Home now plays only once per title until Kodi starts again. The calendar bell is back on the season page for series from other add-ons that still get new episodes. New button in the player menu: What did they say? (10 seconds back with the subtitles on for a moment), with a video add-on that offers it. Add-on settings: the group headings are bigger, with more room above them. 1.40.3: New setting Watching > Close the player menu by itself: while a video plays, the player menu goes away after 3 to 15 seconds without a button press. While a video plays the skin does no background work beyond what is needed, so the box has everything for the picture. On CoreELEC the setup assistant warns when 'Adjust display refresh rate' is off (Dolby Vision needs it), and its button only switches it on. 1.40.2: Series page: the status of the series (Ended, Continuing, Cancelled, In production) is now also shown for series from add-ons and your Kodi library, and the text above the episodes tells what the chosen episode is about. 1.40.1: Scores with logos (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes fresh or rotten, RT audience, Metacritic, Letterboxd) in the lists and on the info page, via Skin settings > Rating logos > Fetch. 1.40.0: The settings screen of add-ons is new, in three columns: groups, settings and a card that explains the focused setting (for the video add-on of the Lucent repository with a tile and picture per group). New icons of Lucent parts show as soon as Kodi starts again.
